meta.tagline: Gold-led capital, managed in your own account.
meta.story: A firm managing private clients' own broker accounts across precious metals, proprietary algorithmic strategies, digital assets, and select alternatives, since 2023.

hero.lead: A gold-led programme, algorithmically informed, run inside your own account. Your money never leaves your name.

folio.label: The arrangement
folio.title: Your account, your name
folio.body: The account is opened with a broker in your name, not ours. We are given authority to trade it. Nothing is pooled, so nothing depends on what another client does.

home.registersLead: The book is led by metal. Everything else earns its place against it.

registers.name: Precious metals
registers.body: Gold first, and silver where it earns the room. This is the centre of gravity of the book rather than a hedge bolted on at the edge of it.

registers.name: Algorithmic strategies
registers.body: Systematic models, executed to written rules and without discretion at the point of execution. The mechanics are the firm's own and are not disclosed.

registers.name: Digital assets
registers.body: A capped allocation to the largest and most liquid digital assets. Sized to be survivable in every case, and decisive in none.

registers.name: Select alternatives
registers.body: Positions taken outside the listed markets, one at a time, and only where the firm can see the whole of what it is buying.

home.leadIntro: KJC Capital manages private clients' own broker accounts across four registers.
home.leadBody: Our approach is deliberate. Four registers, one discipline, and clients whose capital stays in their own name throughout, visible to them at any hour they care to look.

principles.title: Discipline over prediction.
principles.body: The programme is executed to written rules. It is not a view on the direction of any single market, nor a story about macroeconomic conditions. It is a process, applied consistently, day after day.

principles.title: Capacity is a risk decision.
principles.body: The size of the book is set by what the programme can execute without degrading it, and by nothing else. Capacity is reviewed rather than assumed, and it is the firm's decision to make, not the market's.

principles.title: Nothing you cannot see.
principles.body: Because the account is yours, the record is yours: every position and every trade, in your own login, as it happens. A pooled fund can offer one number a month. This arrangement cannot hide anything from you, by construction rather than by promise.

cadence.label: How it works
cadence.title: Four steps, and none of them move your money.
cadence.lead: The account is opened by you, funded by you, and closed by you. We are only ever given permission to trade inside it.

steps.title: You open the account.
steps.body: An account with a broker, in your name, with your identification and your credentials. We help you through it, but it is your account and it always remains so.

steps.title: You grant trading authority.
steps.body: A limited authority that lets us place trades in the account. It is granted by you, it is narrow, and it can be withdrawn by you at any time without asking us.

steps.title: The programme runs.
steps.body: Four registers, executed to written rules. You can watch every position and every trade from your own login while it happens. Nothing is reported to you second-hand.

steps.title: You take money out.
steps.body: Withdrawals are instructed by you to the broker. We do not hold your capital, so we are not a step in taking it back, and there is nothing for us to gate or delay.

home.outroBody: The programme is offered by introduction. If it appears to fit, write to us, and a director will reply personally. Replies are ordinarily within two business days.
home.outroSignoff: The firm is not registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and does not accept U.S. persons.

firm.metaDescription: KJC Capital is a private investment firm based in the British Virgin Islands, running a single gold-led programme across four registers since 2023.
firm.leadIntro: KJC Capital is a private investment firm based in the British Virgin Islands. The firm was established in 2023 and runs a single programme on behalf of its clients.

sections.label: History
sections.body: The firm's founding was unassuming. A quantitative approach that had been refined over several years, run first on personal capital and subsequently on the accounts of family and close acquaintances, was formalised in 2023. The purpose of the formalisation was not growth. It was to draw a clear line between the firm's capital and its clients', and to put in writing an arrangement that had until then rested on trust alone.

sections.label: People
sections.body: The firm is small on purpose. Its principals run the same programme on their own capital, in their own accounts, alongside yours. The alignment of interest between the manager and the client is not an aspiration but a structural feature.

sections.label: Domicile
sections.body: The firm is based in the British Virgin Islands. Client capital is never held by the firm at all: it sits in the client's own account with a broker, which is a stronger separation than any policy of ours could provide. The terms of the arrangement are set out in the client agreement rather than on this site.

programme.metaDescription: A gold-led programme across four registers: precious metals, proprietary algorithmic strategies, a bounded digital-asset allocation, and select alternatives.
programme.leadIntro: KJC Capital runs a single, rules-based programme across four registers, inside each client's own account. What follows is a description of the shape of the engagement; the mechanics of the strategy itself are the firm's proprietary matter and are not disclosed.

sections.label: What it is
sections.body: A discretionary programme, run to written rules and executed algorithmically. The book is led by precious metals and extends into proprietary systematic strategies, a bounded allocation to the most liquid digital assets, and select alternatives taken by exception. Every position is sized against a fixed risk budget.

sections.label: What an investor sees
sections.body: Everything. The account is the client's, so the broker's record is the client's: every position, every trade, every fee, live, through their own login. We do not stand between a client and their own account, and there is no version of the numbers that only we can see. What we ask is restraint rather than ignorance. The programme's edge is in consistency of execution, and watching it hour by hour is a good way to talk yourself out of a process that is working.

sections.label: What it does not do
sections.body: The programme does not offer capital guarantees or targeted returns. The firm does not hold client money, does not take custody of client assets, and does not have authority to withdraw from a client's account. It does not take a position it could not exit in ordinary market conditions. It does not accept US persons as clients.

governance.metaDescription: Where client money sits, the limits on KJC Capital's authority, how the firm is paid, and the record it keeps.
governance.leadIntro: The firm operates within a framework that is intentionally boring. What matters at this size is not the number of controls but that the ones in place are followed, every time.

sections.label: Where the money sits
sections.body: Nothing is pooled. Each client's capital sits in an account with a broker, opened in the client's own name and under the client's own credentials. The firm never takes possession of it. Money is added and withdrawn by the client, instructing the broker directly, which means the firm is not a step in either direction and has nothing to gate.

sections.label: The limits of our authority
sections.body: The firm holds a limited authority to place trades in the client's account, and nothing beyond it. It cannot withdraw, transfer, or pledge a client's assets, and it cannot change who the account belongs to. The authority is granted by the client to the broker, so it is withdrawn the same way, by the client, without the firm's agreement and without notice to us.

sections.label: Valuation
sections.body: The firm does not value your account. Your broker does, on its own statements, from its own records, and those statements are the authoritative account of what you hold and what it is worth. There is no valuation of ours for a broker's figure to disagree with, which removes the question that occupies most of the diligence done on a small manager.

sections.label: Fees
sections.body: The fee basis is stated in the client agreement and agreed before any authority is granted. It is not varied during an engagement without the client's written consent, and it is not deducted by the firm from a client's account on its own initiative, because the firm has no authority to move money out of one.

sections.label: Reporting and records
sections.body: Every instruction the firm places in a client's account is logged, timestamped, and retained. That record is the firm's own, and it is deliberately redundant: the broker holds the same history independently, and the client can read it without asking us. Ours is available on request to any client, and to their counsel, at any time.

contact.metaDescription: The programme is offered by introduction. Write to a director at KJC Capital; replies are ordinarily within two business days.
contact.leadIntro: The programme is offered by introduction. If you would like to explore it, write to a director at the address below. Replies are ordinarily within two business days.

sections.label: By post
sections.body: KJC Capital, Craigmuir Chambers, Road Town, Tortola, British Virgin Islands, VG1110.

sections.label: What to expect
sections.body: A director will reply personally. If, after that exchange, both parties consider the arrangement to be a fit, the firm will issue a client agreement setting out the fee basis and the scope of the trading authority, and will walk you through opening the account in your own name.

portal.metaDescription: Access to the KJC Capital investor portal is issued to clients directly. There is no public sign-up.
portal.leadIntro: Access is issued to clients directly. There is no public sign-up, and nothing behind it that a client cannot already see in their own account.

sections.label: What it holds
sections.body: The record of the relationship. The authority you granted and its exact limits, a log of every material thing the firm did under it, your documents, what you have been charged and the line on your broker statement that matches it, the notices the firm is obliged to give you, and a periodic note from the desk on how the book was being carried.

sections.label: What it does not hold
sections.body: Your balance, your positions and your trades are not here. They sit with your broker, live, under your own login, and that record is the authoritative one. The firm keeps no second set of numbers, and there is no version of your account that only we can see.

sections.label: Access
sections.body: Credentials are issued on account opening, to the client and to nobody else. The portal is in preparation, and clients will be written to directly when it opens. A client who needs something before then should write to a director.

footer.notice: The KJC Capital programme is offered only by introduction, and only to persons the firm has satisfied itself are eligible. Nothing on this site constitutes an offer to the public, a recommendation, or investment advice.
footer.regulatory: KJC Capital is based in the British Virgin Islands. It manages clients' own broker accounts under a limited trading authority and does not hold client money. Terms are set out in the client agreement, provided on introduction.

risk.banner: Capital is at risk. The programme is speculative and may result in the loss of everything committed to it. Past performance is not a guide to future returns. The programme is not available to US persons.
